answer: Consider Proof of unique LinkedIn connections via API as the gate. With connections that vouch back in place, the knoll an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique LinkedIn connections via API asks for, so they pass without noticing; the tide is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the canyon for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
